_note: The 'how it works' film under the landing hero: four shots of five seconds, joined with zoom transitions and held one second on the last frame. Only shots 1 and 4 are generated — text-to-video, sharing the `woman` description below verbatim, which is the only way the same person appears at both ends. Shots 2 and 3 are composited here from her own captures and cost nothing: a 9:19.5 phone standing in the blurred dark of the same steakhouse, its screen filled edge to edge by stacking two of her captures, browser chrome cropped off every layer and her login painted out. Shot 3 also plays the hero clip from her live site inside the phone, behind her headline. Nothing on the glass is invented and no capture is ever sent to a video model, so every word on screen is exactly as she published it.

1-idea.title: She has the idea

tail_push.note: The frame is already diving toward her phone when the transition starts, so the cut into shot 2 finishes a move this shot began.

1-idea.prompt: {woman}. She is standing in a modern, professional western restaurant after service has started: dark stained wood and matte black surfaces, Edison bulbs hanging low and warm overhead, an open grill kitchen behind her with flames glowing softly, deep leather booth seating, two or three customers thrown far out of focus. Premium steakhouse mood, near-black with warm orange light, no bright daylight. She holds her smartphone in one hand and looks down at it, thoughtful, her brow slightly furrowed — and then her face lights up, her eyes widening into a delighted smile, as if she has just had an idea. The warm light from the grill catches one side of her face. Her phone screen is dark and switched off; nothing on it is legible. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no signage, no menu boards, no writing on walls, no labels, no brand logos of any kind, no drinks fridge, no bottles or cans with branding, no watermark, no captions and no subtitles anywhere in frame at any point. Cinematic, photorealistic, moody low-key lighting, warm orange practical light against near-black, shallow depth of field, slow steady push-in. Landscape 16:9.

first_frame.layers_note: Two of her /create captures, stacked, so the glass is full of her own page rather than 40% padding. The first keeps the BinaApp header and ends after the example chips, before the orphan '03' heading; the second starts below its own header so the app chrome is not repeated, and carries her shop name and the story she typed. 3-site.title: Her finished site, hero clip running

first_frame.layers_note: Her hero and then her menu, from two points in her own recording, so the glass is full of her site. Both are taken before or around the point where Chrome's 'No internet connection' banner appears, and each is cropped past whatever chrome that frame happens to have — at 0.4s a URL bar, at 5s the banner and no URL bar, because it had scrolled away.

layers.crop_note: Ends 80px below her 'Lihat menu' button (the orange block runs y=0.789-0.853), not at the navigation bar. The dead space under the buttons was 138px the menu card needed.

redact.note: Her floating chat widget. It is fixed to the viewport, so it appears in every frame of the recording — stacking two of them put two bubbles on one screen. The lower one is kept, where a floating widget belongs.

layers.crop_note: Starts part-way into her Chicken Chop Grill photo rather than at her sticky header. Measured at t=5: the photo runs y=0.278-0.755 and RM14.90 sits at 0.876. Starting higher pushed the price off the bottom of the screen — and the price is the point of showing the menu at all.

hero_video.box_note: The hero block on the composed screen, measured: her sticky header's type ends at 0.038, the block runs dark from 0.076, the Halal badge sits at 0.132-0.151, the headline at 0.186-0.317 and the orange rule at 0.340.
hero_video.darken_note: Her site lays a scrim over this clip; the raw file has none. Measured medians: the capture's hero block is 31, the raw clip 50, so the clip is brought to about two thirds or the block lights up brighter than the page around it.
hero_video.keep_text_note: The luma ramp that decides what stays from the capture and what gives way to the clip. Inside the hero block the darkened photograph sits around 24-40 and her type is 165 and up, so anything between the two separates them; the ramp is there to keep the edges of the letters smooth.

move.note: A slow push toward her hero, where the fire is moving.
